title: ₹1,200 Water Park Ticket: What Does the Owner Keep?
description: No scraped reels this week, so this is reasoning. Our best reel breaks one customer payment into the owner's cut. Water parks are a business many Indian men dream of owning but know nothing about, and the seasonality twist gives a 'where did the profit go' payoff. The cinema popcorn and turf reels already used this kind of hidden-revenue reveal.
text:
FACT SHEET: UNIT ECONOMICS OF AN INDIAN WATER / AMUSEMENT PARK
(For the HISAAB reel. Today is 9 Nov 2026. Most data comes from Wonderla, India's largest listed amusement park chain, and from Imagicaa, which runs water and theme parks.)

**0. SCRIPT WARNINGS (read first)**
- The hook of ₹1,200 for 4 tickets works out to ₹300 per head. That is far below Wonderla's pricing. Wonderla's average realised ticket in Q2 FY27 was ₹983. [https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/wonderla-q2-ebitda-footfall-growth-ppt-cmw1fh5bp009r31ql31frtw2g]
- Listed Bengaluru weekday adult tickets are around ₹1,469 to ₹1,668, and sources conflict. [https://bangaloretoday.in/wonderla-bangalore-ticket-price/] [https://www.nritravelogue.com/asia/discover-india/wonderla-bangalore-ticket-price-and-timings/]
- Some listings show the price plus 18% GST. [https://www.touryatras.com/wonderla-bangalore-ticket-price-rides-guide/]
- I found no audited numbers for a ₹300-ticket regional water park. Either reword the hook to a ~₹4,000 family-of-4 ticket, or say "a ₹300 park" and use only the project-report numbers in section 2.
- I did NOT find sourced figures for electricity bills, water-treatment costs, lifeguard salaries, or locker revenue share. Don't state any.
- CALC means simple arithmetic I did on reported numbers. It is not a company-reported figure.

**1. LAND AND RIDE CAPEX (what the owner puts in before day one)**
- Wonderla Chennai (opened 2 Dec 2025) cost ₹611 crore on 64.3 acres. [https://thefederal.com/category/states/south/tamil-nadu/wonderla-to-open-in-chennai-december-2-216735]
- It has 43 rides and is designed for about 6,500 visitors a day. [https://thefederal.com/category/states/south/tamil-nadu/wonderla-to-open-in-chennai-december-2-216735]
- Over half of that spend goes into new rides and experiences. [https://www.whalesbook.com/news/English/tourism/Wonderlas-Rs-600-Cr-Chennai-Mega-Park-Indias-Thrill-Seekers-Ready-for-Next-Big-Ride/69143e7dfe1fdf16c8ea3543]
- One roller coaster alone costs ₹70-80 crore, per the chairman. [https://thefederal.com/category/states/south/tamil-nadu/wonderla-to-open-in-chennai-december-2-216735]
- Another report quotes ₹60-70 crore for the same ride. [https://www.whalesbook.com/news/English/tourism/Wonderlas-Rs-600-Cr-Chennai-Mega-Park-Indias-Thrill-Seekers-Ready-for-Next-Big-Ride/69143e7dfe1fdf16c8ea3543]
- A new coaster planned for the Bengaluru park costs ₹25-30 crore. [https://www.whalesbook.com/news/English/tourism/Wonderlas-Rs-600-Cr-Chennai-Mega-Park-Indias-Thrill-Seekers-Ready-for-Next-Big-Ride/69143e7dfe1fdf16c8ea3543]
- Older Wonderla parks cost less:
  - Kochi: ₹75 crore.
  - Bengaluru: about ₹105 crore on 82 acres.
  - Hyderabad: ₹115 crore on 50 acres.
  - [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wonderla]
- Maintenance capex runs 6-7% of topline, per the CFO. The MD said about 10% of each park's revenue goes into new rides or expansion. [https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/wonderla-q1fy27-97215]
- Wonderla's in-house ride design and manufacturing is cited as a cost-efficiency driver. [https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202410121010_Wonderla_Holidays_Limited.pdf]

**Smaller-scale benchmarks (consultant/vendor estimates, not audited)**
- Water park, small: 2-5 acres, 8-12 attractions, ₹5-15 crore. [https://www.entrepreneurindia.co/blogs/water-park-business-in-india-2/]
